limitations: The audit observes only resources and connections naturally initiated by the public terminal page.
An authentication wall is classified as product behavior, not automatically as a defect.
Market-data liveness is not inferred outside an active trading session.
One cold run per profile is diagnostic evidence and must be repeated before making a stable latency claim.
